name: Yuujaku Bourou
source:
The main character can't leave her village for certain reasons.
On the night her childhood friend comes home,
she gets lost in another world.
If she stays there for five days, she will die.
To return, she has to borrow the powers of a self-proclaimed god
and look for the scattered pieces of her soul...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/27388]Freem![/url]]
translation:
主人公因某些缘故，无法离开自己的村庄。
青梅竹马归来的那个夜晚，
她迷失在了另一个世界。
如果在这里待上五天，她就会死去。
为了回家，她必须借助自称神明者的力量，
寻找散落各处的灵魂碎片……

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/27388]Freem![/url]]
